```{r}
library(dtw)
library(prospectr)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
```



```{r}
# Loading the data, concatenating the top (A) and bottom (B) parts of the cores

load_data = function(folder, file) {
  file_path = file.path(folder, file)
  df = read_excel(
    path = file_path,
    sheet = 1
  )
  df = subset(df, select = -c(image_row_px, layer_title))
  return(df)
}

core_3A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_A.xlsx")
core_3B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-03_B.xlsx")

core_4A = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_A.xlsx")
core_4B = load_data("Data", "MI-24-04_B.xlsx")


core_3 = bind_rows(
  core_3A,
  core_3B |> mutate(depth_mm = depth_mm + max(core_3A$depth_mm))
)

core_4 = bind_rows(
  core_4A,
  core_4B |> mutate(depth_mm = depth_mm + max(core_4A$depth_mm))
)

```



```{r}
#Smoothing the cielab tracks

smooth_cols = function(df, window) {
  for (axis in c("L_star", "a_star", "b_star")) {
    df[[paste0(axis, "_smooth_", window)]] =
      as.numeric(stats::filter(df[[axis]], rep(1/window, window), sides = 2))
  }
  df
}

for (window in c(5, 11, 21, 41)) {
  core_3A = smooth_cols(core_3A, window)
  core_3B = smooth_cols(core_3B, window)
  core_4A = smooth_cols(core_4A, window)
  core_4B = smooth_cols(core_4B, window)
}
```


```{r}
# Plotting a single dim from both cores

series_1 = core_3B
series_2 = core_4B
axis = "L_star_smooth_41"


plot_df = bind_rows(
  series_1 |> mutate(series = "Series 1"),
  series_2 |> mutate(series = "Series 2")
) |>
  filter(!is.na(.data[[axis]]), !is.na(depth_mm))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = .data[[axis]], y = depth_mm)) +
  geom_path(colour = "blue") +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  facet_wrap(~ series, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = axis,
    y = "Depth (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    aspect.ratio = 5
  )

```


```{r}
# Running dynamic time warping (dtw) algo

alignment <- dtw(
  core_3$L_star,
  core_4$L_star,
  keep.internals = TRUE
)
plot(alignment, type = "threeway")

```


```{r}

plot_ccf = function(lag_mm, correlation) {
  df = data.frame(
    lag_mm = lag_mm,
    correlation = correlation
  )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = lag_mm, y = correlation)) +
    geom_line(colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(
      x = "Depth lag (mm)",
      y = "Pearson correlation (r)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
}
```


```{r}
# Performing a Pearson cross-correlation


series_1 <- core_3B
series_2 <- core_4B

axis <- "L_star_smooth_41"

depth_step <- 0.5
max_lag_mm <- 1000



# Common overlapping depth range
depth_min <- max(
  min(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  min(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
)

depth_max <- min(
  max(series_1$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
  max(series_2$depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Common depth grid
depth <- seq(
  depth_min,
  depth_max,
  by = depth_step
)

# Interpolate onto common depth grid
x1 <- approx(
  x = series_1$depth_mm,
  y = series_1[[axis]],
  xout = depth,
  ties = mean
)$y

x2 <- approx(
  x = series_2$depth_mm,
  y = series_2[[axis]],
  xout = depth,
  ties = mean
)$y

# Remove positions where either profile is NA
valid <- !is.na(x1) & !is.na(x2)

x1 <- x1[valid]
x2 <- x2[valid]

# Cross-correlation
result <- ccf(
  x1,
  x2,
  lag.max = max_lag_mm / depth_step,
  plot = FALSE
)

# Convert lag to actual depth offset in mm
lag_mm <- as.vector(result$lag) * depth_step
correlation <- as.vector(result$acf)

# Plot
plot_ccf(
  lag_mm,
  correlation
)

# Best correlation and corresponding depth offset
i <- which.max(correlation)

best_correlation <- correlation[i]
best_offset_mm <- lag_mm[i]

best_correlation
best_offset_mm
```
